passages.title: Williams Oops Reversals and ORB on Liquid Momentum Names
passages.text: Use Williams Oops reversals and opening range breakouts to catch trapped traders on liquid momentum names like TSLA and ABNB. When a stock gaps down into support and immediately reclaims the previous day's low, the shorts get caught off guard. Take that reversal quickly or wait for the ORB to confirm buyers are fully in control. That gap-trap dynamic gives an immediate, low-risk entry.
